current_slice: RFC-003 Milestone 4 Slice 4F — Workspace ownership transfer
forbidden_scope: Any product change outside the exact five allowed_paths above
Any change to WorkspaceManager::transferOwnership(), or any other WorkspaceManager method
Any change to WorkspaceOwnershipTransferDisposition, WorkspaceOwnershipTransferMode, or WorkspaceBusinessAccessScope
Any repository, model, migration, event, exception, DTO, or enum change of any kind
Any modification to tests/Feature/Workspace/WorkspaceOwnershipTransferTest.php, or to any prior-slice test merely to make Slice 4F pass
Any new User repository, or a global User directory/search feature
Any caller-supplied numeric User, Business, Workspace, membership, owner, tenant, or customer ID accepted anywhere in the request path — opaque uids only
Any alternate Workspace or Business authorization algorithm, including in Blade/controller UI filtering
Any controller-side ownership write, membership reconciliation, workspace_transitions write, or event dispatch that duplicates WorkspaceManager
Any third or default previous-owner disposition; the caller must always choose explicitly between deactivate and convert_to_admin
Any automatic Milestone 4 closure or next-Milestone selection after Slice 4F completion — that remains a separate future human governance action
Setting advance_automatically true, setting start_automatically_after_contract_merge true, changing merge_policy from human_only, or weakening exact-scope or positive-test gates
Using a metered model API, enabling usage credits, requiring Codex review for completion, an automatic model handoff, merging automatically, force-pushing, pushing directly to main, or tagging

Any Slice 4F implementation work before this authorization pull request is itself human-reviewed and merged — PR #52 at pinned head c24af2212e017a66ab8fc42c7bcbba3d469dda72 is the only authorized implementation target once that happens
